CORE CAPABILITIES

01

Regulatory & CMC

CTD/eCTD Modules 1–5, CMC fundamentals and submission concepts. FORGE portfolio work applies Module 3 mapping and CMC gap assessment; BEACON applies official-source regulatory change review. FDA, EMA/EU, CDSCO and ICH source orientation; IND/NDA/ANDA/DMF concepts.

02

Quality & data integrity

GMP, GLP, GCP, QbD, quality risk management, change control, deviation/CAPA and ALCOA+ concepts. BEACON, FORGE and LEDGER-Q work samples keep missing or conflicting evidence visible, preserve revision history and require human review; this is portfolio practice, not a compliance qualification.

03

Analytical workflow

BEACON: official-source comparison, exact evidence links, uncertainty and documented review. FORGE: source-linked facts, numbers/units/batch context, CMC gaps, Module 3 draft candidates and independent checks. LEDGER-Q: quality events, evidence gaps, CAPA checks, AI-use boundaries and audit history. All three preserve source revisions and human decision boundaries.

04

Working strengths

Analytical problem solving, attentive documentation, professional communication and careful source review, demonstrated through independent regulatory/CMC work samples and academic research.

A connected CMC evidence thread.

Latest refinements: Module 2.3 draft support and source-linked completeness checks for analytical procedures, stability, post-approval work, authority responses and external handoff. These checks expose gaps; they do not establish method validation, shelf life or agency acceptance.

FORGE preserves permitted originals and their versions, carries typed values, units, methods, batches and evidence spans into 3.2.S / 3.2.P draft candidates, and checks numbers, citations and completeness independently. Source changes reopen affected work and its exact-revision review.

The saved parent workflow manages dependencies, leases, bounded retries, pause, cancellation and replan. In AI-assisted mode, a bounded planner allocates approved facts to up to two parallel author specialists; a distinct model checks each merged statement before technical QC and human review. Configured Groq routing has a saved live synthetic receipt; missing or failed configuration stays HOLD. Deterministic work remains available through an explicit fallback.

What I designed and demonstrated

Latest refinements: full preserved-text comparison with exact offsets, versioned product/site/market/dossier/source mapping, additional declared context, cited obligation records and named review tasks. Company applicability stays UNKNOWN or UNASSESSED until qualified review.

BEACON connects source and version traceability to candidate applicability, document impact, evidence gaps, a named human decision and revision-bound closure. It distinguishes SOURCE_FAILED from NO_CHANGE; draft or withdrawn material remains visibly labelled.

The latest hosted MVP adds model-selected bounded planning, separate analyst/reviewer routes, exact-citation checks, model-identity and completion gates, role receipts, and a saved evidence cockpit, grouped workflow navigation, product/site/market/dossier/source mapping, human review, independent closure and a protected public-source updater with explicit source-health gaps. Source failures and overdue checks remain visible; listing discovery does not establish a validated regulatory change. The separate FastAPI/LangGraph pilot remains a historical codebase.
